_meta.forward_revision_notes: v3 adds forward-looking indicators per REIT: distribution_frequency, forecast_dpu_cents (all null - no group-1 REIT publishes a numeric forward DPU forecast; these are established REITs, not recent IPOs), rental_reversion_pct, pct_debt_due_12m, dpu_change_per_100bps_pct (MAS-style rate sensitivity), and dpu_yoy_pct. All values re-sourced from the manager's most recent results presentation / SGXNet financial statement, extracted via pipeline/extract_pdf.cjs where the primary PDF was image/binary. DPU rate sensitivity: C38U, HMN, M44U, N2IU, K71U, AJBU disclose an explicit DPU/DPS-per-rate-move figure; A17U and ME8U disclose ONLY the MAS ICR sensitivity (no DPU sensitivity), so their dpu_change_per_100bps_pct is null. pct_debt_due_12m null for A17U/N2IU/AJBU because the per-year maturity bars are image-rendered (chart-only) with no text-stated single-year %.
